locked_title: ProvGuard: Origin-Labeled Perception and Causal Action Attribution for Mobile GUI Agents
required_core_terms: no LLM judge in the trusted path
required_equations: provenance record r(v) = (uid, wtype, origin, sender, sens, perc) per node v and per tile
label lattice L = {user, system, app-first-party, web, ad/SDK, notification-untrusted} with join
perceivability bit perc(v) in {0,1} from occlusion, off-screen, contrast, rendered
causal dependency set D(a) subset of observed regions for protected action a
masked re-execution test: a' = Agent(s, M_U(o)); attribute to untrusted content iff a' != a
integrity property: a dispatched without endorsement implies D(a) contains no untrusted-origin or non-perceivable region
binding predicate: (token_obs, node_obs) == (token_now, node_now) at dispatch
repeated-trial confidence rule for stochastic agents
cost: model calls per protected action = 1 + k (k re-execution trials)
required_algorithm_names: masked re-execution (MELON-style, adapted to GUI steps)
required_theorem_directions: gate soundness: no un-endorsed protected action whose causal dependency set includes untrusted-origin or user-invisible content, relative to the masked re-execution oracle and stated assumptions
dispatch binding rejects observe-to-act rebinding (foreground change / node change)
masked re-execution validity and stochastic confidence rule with misattribution probability bound
label join monotonicity over the lattice; perceivability composition
property is weaker than IFC / non-interference; gap stated explicitly
cost: masked re-execution adds model calls only on protected actions
required_experiment_variables: false block rate on benign tasks
channels: in-app third-party content, SDK Runtime ads, WebView, notifications, hidden/low-contrast nodes, repackaged-app desync, foreground rebinding, adaptive paraphrased payloads
attack suites: AgentHazard (AWAttackerApplier), MobileWorldSafety, GhostEI-Bench, Not-an-A11y nine vectors, UI Desynchronization, arXiv 2510.27140 channel attacks
ablations: labels only, gate only, binding only, perceivability bit on/off, cheap attribution vs masked re-execution
forbidden_topic_drifts: cloud tool-calling agents as the primary setting
model fine-tuning as the proposed defense
OS-side LLM judge in the trusted path
TEE / hardware enclave as the mechanism
non-interference claimed as the achieved property
post-hoc trajectory auditing as the method
measurement-only paper (unless killer experiment forces it)
